scope: Static source/evidence integrity review only; no experiment or holdout replay performed.
finding: The recorded GEO1 HOLDOUT-DTI is not a valid comparable holdout claim. The source masks prediction eligibility with the full catalogue, including the withheld labels, contrary to the shared SegmentHoldout visible-only rule. The nonzero recorded TP_w is inconsistent with the pinned eligibility path, which cannot emit any hidden catalogue pixel.

source_findings.meaning: Loads the full labelled catalogue once, before iterating folds.
Uses the full catalogue, rather than fold-visible f["visible"], to exclude predictions.
Every withheld truth pixel belongs to the full label raster passed as catalogue.

source_findings.code: ``visible`` is the ONLY catalogue a detector may read.
source_findings.meaning: Shared SegmentHoldout contract; fold-visible labels are provided as f["visible"].
The shared priority_poisson emitter cannot emit a pixel excluded by eligible.

rejected_recorded_result.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (rejected; do not compare or promote)
rejected_recorded_result.reason: A correct execution of the pinned eligibility path has zero predicted pixels on hidden labels; the archived nonzero TP_w cannot be reproduced from that path. The cause of the discrepancy is not established without a controlled replay, which was not authorized or run.

limitations: Static source analysis is sufficient to reject the reported number as a valid holdout, but does not establish which source bytes were actually executed if the archived result was generated before the recorded hashes were written.
The source-level fix belongs in a new, explicitly assigned experiment lane; this review does not modify the historical GEO1 runner or generate a replacement result.
